scope: Actual source-bound visual decisions. Indices13/18 supersede earlier overview approvals after full raw recheck, retaining both decisions. Indistinct ornaments receive conservative footprint corrections without inferring historical identity. These are art failures, not service refusals. No retry count reset or new image call.

decisions.reason: Actual native original and full raw inspection: the source has only fine pale-grey upper-lip detail, while the return grows a broad dense triangular grey moustache. Reduce this to the actual very narrow faint upper-lip appearance, with smooth clean chin. Preserve the grey-brown side-parted hair, khaki jacket, pale shirt, black tie and original card/background. Do not infer extra facial hair from lip/nose shading.
